    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      获取这个事件是否被取消.一个被取消的事件不会在服务器里执行，但是仍然会传递事件到其他插件.

      原文： Gets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins

      取消此事件将立即关闭连接，且不会向客户端发送响应。

      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      如果事件已经被取消，则为true

      原文：true if this event is cancelled

    • setCancelled

      public void setCancelled(boolean cancel)
      取消这个事件. 一个被取消的事件不会在 服务器里执行，但是仍然会传递事件到其他插件.

      原文： Sets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins.

      取消此事件将立即关闭连接，且不会向客户端发送响应。

      指定者:
      setCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      参数:
      cancel - 如果你想取消这个事件，则为true

      原文：true if you wish to cancel this event

    • iterator

      @NotNull @Deprecated(forRemoval=true, since="1.20.6") public @NotNull java.util.Iterator<Player> iterator()
      已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
      Iterable 接口将在某个时候被移除

      调用Iterator.remove()方法将会强制部分玩家不会在玩家列表里显示，减小ServerListPingEvent.getNumPlayers()返回的大小，并且不会再被任何一个新的迭代器返回.
      注意: 如果 Bukkit.getHideOnlinePlayers() 为 true, 则在 ServerListPingEvent.iterator() 内的玩家不会被展示到 motd 信息上.

      原文：

      Calling the Iterator.remove() method will force that particular player to not be displayed on the player list, decrease the size returned by ServerListPingEvent.getNumPlayers(), and will not be returned again by any new iterator.
      Note: The players here will not be shown in the server info if Bukkit.getHideOnlinePlayers() is true.

      Note: For compatibility reasons, this method will return all online players, not just the ones referenced in getPlayerSample(). Removing a player will:

      • Decrement the online player count (if and only if) the player count wasn't changed by another plugin before.
      • Remove all entries from getPlayerSample() that refer to the removed player (based on their UUID).
      指定者:
      iterator 在接口中 java.lang.Iterable<Player>
      覆盖:
      iterator 在类中 ServerListPingEvent
